cases.label: Simple Environmental Prop (crate, barrel, lamp, hydrant)
required_tools_ordered: parallax study <name> (or parallax make <name> if fast prop)
per-part a.cad / measured code or checked CC ref mesh

forbidden_tools.why: Whole-object generators with projected textures produce low-fidelity props that do not match sourced sizes.
Projected textures skip UV layout and fail Roblox texture fidelity requirements.
Crispness-weighted scoring picks the sharpest render, not the most accurate mesh.

cases.capability_policy: Full-capability, case-matched execution (NEVER artificially minimal): use the ENTIRE pipeline whenever the piece benefits from it; `required_tools_ordered` is the quality floor, extra non-forbidden pipeline tools are ALWAYS allowed, `forbidden_tools` blocks ONLY tools that degrade this case, and edge-case skips require `--skip-tool <tool> --why "<reason>"` logged to `.verify/parallax_session.json`.
examples: make a wooden crate for the market stall
build a stone lantern prop for the courtyard
add a metal barrel environmental piece

cases.label: Machined/Engineered Hero Weapon, Firearm, Vehicle, Mechanism
required_tools_ordered: a.cad (fillet_mm, redraw(pts) tangent) + a.pillow for crowned plates/triggers + cad_parts ISO small parts + a.stamp / a.ornament

forbidden_tools.why: 2D side-outline extrusion without sections/pillow produces flat slabs with no depth.
Flat extruded trigger has no mechanical detail and reads as placeholder geometry.
Whole-object generators warp hard-surface blades/barrels; generate organic PARTS only.
Colour-threshold panel tracing loses precise edge geometry required for machined surfaces.

cases.label: Creature, Head, Skull, Statue, Sculpted Organic Ornament
required_tools_ordered: a.import_mesh (measured size, own maps, no mat=) OR checked CC ref mesh as clay (fit_to / a.form_match)

forbidden_tools.why: Hand-coded SDF primitives for creatures/crests plateau at 1/10 — cannot produce believable organic surfaces.
Using a single concept image for the whole hero skips per-part resolution; each part needs its own sourced reference.

parallax blockout <name> -> parallax approve 3d <name> --by owner --stage blockout
